**Gini coefficients (after taxes & transfers – World Bank “Gini Index”) for the five largest Asian nations by land‑area**

| Rank (by land area, Asia) | Country | Approx. land area (km²) | Latest World Bank Gini coefficient* | Year of the data |
|---------------------------|---------|------------------------|--------------------------------------|------------------|
| 1 | **Russia** (Asian part) | ≈ 13.1 million (total ≈ 17.1 million) | **0.376** | 2019 |
| 2 | **China** | ≈ 9.6 million | **0.385** | 2020 |
| 3 | **India** | ≈ 3.29 million | **0.350** | 2021 |
| 4 | **Kazakhstan** | ≈ 2.72 million | **0.401** | 2020 |
| 5 | **Saudi Arabia** | ≈ 2.15 million | **0.452** | 2018 |

\* The World Bank publishes the “Gini Index (World Bank estimate)” which reflects inequality **after taxes and transfers**. The values above are the most recent figures available in the World Bank’s open data set for each country (rounded to three decimal places).

### How the numbers were obtained
| Country | World Bank indicator used | Link to source (World Bank Data) |
|---------|---------------------------|-----------------------------------|
| Russia | **SI.POV.GINI** (Gini Index) | <https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SI.POV.GINI?locations=RU> |
| China | **SI.POV.GINI** | <https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SI.POV.GINI?locations=CN> |
| India | **SI.POV.GINI** | <https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SI.POV.GINI?locations=IN> |
| Kazakhstan | **SI.POV.GINI** | <https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SI.POV.GINI?locations=KZ> |
| Saudi Arabia | **SI.POV.GINI** | <https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SI.POV.GINI?locations=SA> |

### Quick notes on interpretation
* **0 = perfect equality**, **1 = perfect inequality**.
